Name: Inushi Daiyokai
Source: Lyres Guide to Risk and Reward
Information:
**Inushi**

Inushi, wolf yokai, manifest in response to the desires of those who prey upon others. The thrill of the hunt a serial killer experiences, or the misery of those preyed upon by a miser they owe their livelihood to may cause wolf yokai to appear. Once they appear they go about hunting wildlife and mortals who stray too far from their communities. They are drawn to those who are victimized already and are known to eat their way up the food chain until they eventually reach the source of the misery and subjugation that birthed them. When they finally consume the predator who brought them into being they move on, searching for more victims.

***Control Over Wolves.*** Inushi can exert supernatural control over regular wolves, causing them to recognize them as their pack leader. Inushi often incorporate regular wolves into their packs to help them hunt, letting them feed on meat that is not soaked in misery and contempt.

***Greater Inushi.*** Inushi who live long enough evolve into much larger iterations of their predecessors, taking on a phantom-like appearance with wisping fur and bone-like spikes erupting from their joints and spines.

**Inushi Daiyokai’s Lair**

An inushi daiyokai may establish a den for themselves, from which they command and organize their subservient lesser inushi. This lair becomes a place where their inushi can pass between the Realm of Shadows and the plane they are on relatively freely, allowing them to return to the plane the lair is on quickly if they are killed outside the Realm of Shadow. Their den is usually a wide cavernous space littered with the corpses of prey and victims - though yokai don’t require nourishment from food, an inushi daiyokai may develop a taste for meat as a means of pleasure.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The yokai makes two Claw attacks, then one Bite or Wolf Fang Spear attack.

actions.name: Bite (Yokai Form Only)
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 29 (4d10 + 7) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 10 ft. (yokai form) or reach 5 ft. (humanoid form), one target. Hit: 21 (3d8 + 7) slashing damage.

actions.name: Wolf Fang Spear (Humanoid Form Only)
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target, or thrown as a Ranged Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 3d8 + 7 piercing damage. If thrown, the weapon returns to the yokai immediately. A creature hit by this attack must make a DC 21 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Regurgitate Inushi (Recharge 6)
actions.description: The yokai vomits 1d6+1 inushi or 1d4+1 (minimum 1) greater inushi, who appear in spaces adjacent to the yokai. They then roll initiative immediately and take their turns as they come. These inushi have no sense of individuality and mentally follow the yokai’s orders, vanishing into smoke when they die, after 24 hours pass, or when the yokai uses this feature again. If these inushi are incapacitated or suffer a critical hit they immediately die.

actions.name: Shadow Gate (1/Day)
actions.description: As an action, the yokai replicates the effects of the shadow gate spell.

bonus_actions.name: Change Shape
bonus_actions.description: The yokai transforms into a Medium or Small Elven humanoid, a Large wolf, or into its true form. It retains its statistics across all forms except for its size. If it dies it returns to its true form.

bonus_actions.name: Chase
bonus_actions.description: The yokai takes the Dash action and must move toward one creature it can see within 60 feet. The next attack it makes this turn against that target has advantage.

options.name: Attack
options.description: The yokai makes a Bite or Wolf Fang Spear attack.

options.name: Weary Eye (Costs 2 Actions)
options.description: The yokai forces up to three creatures it can see within 60 feet to make a DC 18 Charisma saving throw. On a failure they are subjected to resentment and emotional turmoil, and become sluggish until the end of the yokai’s next turn.

options.name: Command Inushi (X Actions)
options.description: The yokai commands a number of inushi equal to the number of Legendary Actions it spends on this effect, allowing each of them to use their Bite attack once against a target within range or move up to their movement speed.

lair_actions.intro: On initiative count 20 (losing initiative ties), yokai can take one of the following lair actions; he cannot take the same lair action two rounds in a row:

options.name: Blood Frenzy
options.description: The yokai and all inushi demons it commands can take one extra weapon attack as part of their Multiattack action on their next turn. The yokai must use this to make a Claw attack.

options.name: Dread Howling
options.description: The yokai creates an effect that is identical to the fear spell (no concentration required), targeting all creatures the yokai can see and chooses, requiring a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw to resist it. Any creature that fails has become inflicted with fear for 1 minute as per the spell’s effects. If a creature succeeds their save (or the ongoing save against it), they cannot be affected by it again for 24 hours. This effect also ends if the yokai uses another lair action.

options.name: Iron Coat
options.description: The yokai and up to five inushi yokai it commands gain 20 temporary hit points. Alternatively, the yokai alone gains 50 temporary hit points.

options.name: Retching Scent
options.description: The smell of corpses and decay is heightened. All creatures in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point the yokai chooses within his lair must make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw. Any creature that fails is poisoned for 1 round (until initiative count 20 the following round).

legendary_reactions.source_conversion_note: Converted from Legendary Resistance (3/Day) per standing formatting rule.
